# Ghar Banwao

Ghar Banwao is a construction company headquartered in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh,
India. It offers complete home construction, architecture, interior design and
renovation across Lucknow, Kanpur, Ayodhya, Gorakhpur, Vindhyachal, Prayagraj,
Sitapur, Sultanpur, Basti, Lakhimpur, Fatehpur and Rai Bareilly. Since 2017 it
has handed over 264+ homes and currently has 52 sites live, with a 25-year
structural warranty and a transparent per-square-foot cost calculator.

## Facts

- Est. 2017; 264+ homes handed over, 52 projects ongoing, 316 total projects.
- Google rating 4.8/5 from 250+ reviews; 25-year structural warranty.
- Packages priced at ₹1,299/sqft (Silver, default), ₹1,699/sqft (Gold) and
  ₹1,999/sqft (Platinum); the quote is a 9-stage, work-linked payment schedule.
- WhatsApp: +91 91980 59992 · Phone: +91 96482 49999 · support@gharbanwao.com
- Office: 16/284, near Munshipulia, next to Ashirwad Bakery, Indira Nagar,
  Lucknow 226016, Uttar Pradesh, India.
